## Expected and actual behavior

Describe the concrete failure and what should have happened.

## Reproduction

Commit, Python version, platform, and exact command or smallest fixture. State whether the evidence is live, replay or mocked. Include the client version only if relevant.

## Decision trace, if relevant

What was observed? Which candidates were offered? What did Sage select? What executed, and what changed afterward?

Attach a small sanitized excerpt. Remove credentials, account and character details, other players' names and chat, and local machine paths; do not attach whole raw databases or recordings.
